_doc: UI test of the view-mode bar (studio/viewmodes.js) in the Forge and The Map Room. Forge: the bar sits on the view, Clay keeps the leaf cards' outline (the own colour map as alpha), the shadow shapes are left alone and the shadow roles come back after Wireframe, Normals is a normal matcap with the alpha, Edges follows the meshes, and real Z then 3 picks a mode from the pie. Map Room: five modes, Clay keeps the brush ring and stays when the stage view changes underneath, Material shows the stage view, Edges uses the node material pushed out along the normal. Nothing is written to disk. The creator's own test is creator_viewmodes.json. Run against studio-test: url with port 8771.
name: viewmodes

steps.eval: (() => { const V = __studio.viewModes; window.__meshes = () => { const a = []; __studio.current.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && !o.userData.vmOverlay) a.push(o); }); return a; }; window.__fbtn = (id) => document.querySelector(`.vm-forge .vm-btn[data-mode="${id}"]`); __fbtn('material').click(); window.__cast = __meshes().map((o) => o.castShadow); const own = (o) => o.userData.own ?? o.material; return { mode: V.mode, meshes: __meshes().map((o) => [o.name, o.material.type, !!own(o).map, own(o).alphaTest, !!own(o).userData?.shadowProxy, o.castShadow]) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.vm-forge').getBoundingClientRect(), side = document.querySelector('#side').getBoundingClientRect(); return !document.querySelector('.vm-forge').hidden && r.width > 200 && r.right <= side.left && document.querySelector('.vm-forge').closest('#app') && document.querySelectorAll('.vm-forge .vm-btn').length === 9; })()
steps.label: the Forge's bar sits on the view, left of the side panel, with 7 modes and 2 overlays
Material shows the models' own materials

steps.expect: (() => { const m = __meshes(), cut = m.filter((o) => o.userData.own.map && (o.userData.own.alphaTest > 0 || o.userData.own.transparent) && !o.userData.own.userData?.shadowProxy), solid = m.filter((o) => !o.userData.own.userData?.shadowProxy && !cut.includes(o)); return cut.length > 0 && cut.every((o) => o.material.type === 'MeshStandardMaterial' && o.material.alphaMap === o.userData.own.map && o.material.alphaTest > 0) && solid.length > 0 && solid.every((o) => o.material !== o.userData.own && !o.material.map); })()
steps.label: Clay draws the tree in one material and the leaf cards keep their outline
the shadow shapes are left alone and the shadow roles stay as they were

steps.expect: (() => { const m = __meshes().filter((o) => !o.userData.own.userData?.shadowProxy); return m.every((o) => o.material.type === 'MeshMatcapMaterial' && o.material.toneMapped === false) && m.some((o) => !!o.material.alphaMap) && __meshes().every((o, i) => o.castShadow === __cast[i]); })()
steps.label: Normals is a normal matcap that keeps the cards' alpha, and the shadows come back

steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelector('.vm-forge button[aria-label="Edges"]').click(); let n = 0; __studio.current.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) n++; }); return n; })()

steps.expect: (() => { let n = 0, ok = 0; __studio.current.traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) { n++; if (o.geometry === o.parent.geometry && o.visible) ok++; } }); return n > 0 && n === ok; })()
steps.label: Edges lays a wire overlay over the tree's meshes
a real Z press opens the pie

steps.eval: (() => { const T = __studio.terrain; window.__ground = () => { let g = null; T.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && !o.userData.vmOverlay && o.userData.own && (!g || o.geometry.attributes.position?.count > g.geometry.attributes.position?.count)) g = o; }); return g; }; window.__tbtn = (id) => document.querySelector(`.vm-low2 .vm-btn[data-mode="${id}"]`); __tbtn('material').click(); window.__shaded = __ground().material; return { modes: T.viewModes.modes, forgeHidden: !document.querySelector('.vm-forge').checkVisibility() }; })()

steps.label: the Map Room has its own bar with five modes; the Forge's is hidden
Clay draws the ground in clay (a node material with the brush ring)
a new stage view underneath leaves Clay in place
Material shows the stage view picked above

steps.eval: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll('.stagebar button')].find((b) => b.dataset.id === 'shaded').click(); __tbtn('matcap').click(); document.querySelector('.vm-low2 button[aria-label="Edges"]').click(); let e = null; __ground().traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) e = o; }); return { type: __ground().material.type, edge: !!e, pos: !!e?.material.positionNode }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { let e = null; __ground().traverse((o) => { if (o.userData.vmOverlay) e = o; }); return __ground().material.type.startsWith('MeshMatcap') && !!e && !!e.material.positionNode && __ground().userData.own === __shaded; })()
steps.label: Matcap and Edges work on the WebGPU ground (the edges pushed out along the normal)
